ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE (closeout input for bob-cli-nh.7): Added scripts/obsidian-intention-card-e2e.cjs (+ -lib, -workflows) and offline wrapper scripts/test-obsidian-intention-card-e2e.cjs (in test:unit). Real run under xvfb-run with owned Obsidian 1.x Electron, scratch Git vault/profile, never the live vault; bob built from bob-cli d15432aa (clean), BOB_BIN sha256 b0bcf62b4f4c2a4440c0c0854350877073cb9fbeae278f9c6875a424c9f5b99a (bob 0.5.0); test clock 2026-11-20 America/New_York, plugin today agreed at start/end. Final verdict PASS 65/65 mandatory checks, 0 console exceptions/errors, 11 real writer applies (stdin + results recorded), 37 screenshots all inspected (light/dark, 375px). Proven: Reading + Live Preview placement after H1/nav and above ^gtd, exactly 7 owned keys hidden with unrelated rows visible, restore on unmount/mode change/malformed metadata/plugin disable and recovery; empty/malformed/Source/embed fail open; empty-note ==; open->intention:0, closed->Reflection; [n==r and ==[r end with caret at end of yesterday textarea, no literal r, no writes; add/replace/paste-normalized/soft-cap/Alt+K reorder/Ctrl+D remove/u Undo with byte checks of body + unowned frontmatter and fresh bob reads; multiline reflection Ctrl+Enter save-close; summary explainer, edited provenance, stamp-restoring Undo across reopen; ]/[/= navigation incl. missing day disabled, missing year ensure hint, ISO boundary walk 2026-01-01 -> 2025-12-31/2026-W01/2025-W52/2025-Q4/2026-Q1/2026; palette Edit intentions + Reflect on yesterday; Command Mode rows; Ctrl+Shift+P fallback + task priority; YAML Done returns to subject/selection; invalid YAML stays in Source with notice; two-pane stale refusal keeps draft with no writer call then explicit retry saves; body-only edit survives save; emulated old bob keeps card + Source recovery. Artifacts: report file:explicit:1919355ed6090b82b47ff817; screenshots file:explicit:7dfdbceb0f90c18729a2cf7c; contact sheet file:explicit:f841eb68bf723f242b173ab0; painter previews file:explicit:8ce152c821eec94009654f19 (sheets file:explicit:691e7f45a1092f0a1693d13e, file:explicit:6bf0fea689b815ec8b6d63d1).

DEFECTS FOUND BY REAL ACCEPTANCE AND FIXED (bob-plugins, bob-ledger-tools 1.140.0 -> 1.141.0): (1) Live Preview crash: the card was a block decoration from a ViewPlugin (CodeMirror RangeError "Block decorations may not be specified via plugins") so a daily note with intentions could not open in LP; now an inline widget at the end of the line before the first unrelated block, built lazily, and the toDOM ReferenceError (undefined plugin) fixed. (2) Reading view: the card rendered intention Markdown with the note sourcePath, re-entering its own post-processor in a repaint loop; render containers are now marked and rejected, each card owns a MarkdownRenderChild unloaded with it; the card anchored inside the H1 wrapper (above the nav line) and sizer-level inserts were pruned by Obsidian, so it now appends inside the last H1/nav section with a bounded retry when sections attach late. (3) Editor: stages never received focus/caret; pasted newlines were stripped instead of becoming spaces with a note; stages opened on missing/needs-update subjects; stale refusals never fetched a fresh fingerprint so retry failed again; Undo ignored the path-scoped record after reopen; generation churn from the card own pane save surfaced as a false field-stale error on body-only edits; malformed YAML read as ok+warning let Done reopen the card and the editor treat it as empty; `y` opened Live Preview instead of raw Source. All fixed in new fragment 297ca plus small call-site edits (297c 977 lines). (4) Polish: Reading-view SUMMARY/REFLECTION titles inherited huge h2 sizing, chip/text misalignment from

margins, raw status words, duplicated stale text, bare Edit label. Unit coverage: scripts/test-ledger-tools-intention-card-acceptance.cjs (10 tests). The editor real-writer unit test now runs only with explicit BOB_BIN (it auto-discovered a stale target/debug/bob lacking periods update and failed on the clean base).
